correctness.rationale: With zero-velocity initialization, each eigenmode satisfies p_1=1-alpha*lambda and p_2=(1-alpha*lambda)^2-beta*alpha*lambda. Substitution of the classical parameters gives exact endpoint factors. In dimension two, exact condition number forces the spectrum to the two endpoints, so f(x_2)/f(x_1) is a weighted average of the two squared modal ratios and is maximized at L. Solving that exact ratio <=1 gives kappa<=9+4sqrt(5). In dimension three, 1/alpha lies strictly inside (mu,L); that mode has p_1=0 and p_2=-beta, while arbitrarily small perturbations make the adjacent objective ratio diverge. Exact rational witnesses and identities were replayed from the packaged checker.

value.rationale: Heavy-Ball is a foundational accelerated method, and non-monotone transients motivate restart and safeguard rules. The result gives a sharp structural distinction rather than merely another example: two dimensions admit an exact finite adjacent-step bound and a closed algebraic monotonicity frontier, whereas adding one interior curvature makes the ratio unbounded for every nontrivial condition number. The reset mechanism explains why condition number alone cannot control local objective spikes once an interior spectral mode is available, while the two-dimensional formula quantifies exactly what is still protected.
